baseline: same frozen C45 synthetic task generator and surviving candidate mechanisms used at rungs 125 and 200
purpose: Estimate the productive campaign-size frontier when coordination, verification, context/fusion burden and error exposure increase with campaign size.

overhead_model.context_error_exposure: quality penalty starts after 100 units and grows quadratically

selection_rule: best operating point is the scale with maximum mean net_vcgc among scales that pass all gates
claim_ceiling: synthetic deterministic overhead model only; does not measure actual LLM context limits or real message throughput
